results.snippet: Algeria’s influence weakened substantially following the military coups in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger, as it found itself at odds with the new governments. After Niger’s July 2023 coup, Algiers opposed the removal of President Mohamed Bazoum and rejected the prospect of military intervention by the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).
